## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** 埃及早王朝时期是纪念性墓葬、石材加工与王权建筑技术快速发展的阶段。第一、二王朝墓葬到第三王朝大型石构建筑之间的关系，是理解金字塔时代工程传统形成的重要背景。但单个墓葬能否被称为“金字塔前身”，必须依靠可靠年代、建筑比较与正式发表，而不能仅凭墙体收分这一普遍工程特征。

**English.** The Early Dynastic period saw rapid development in elite funerary architecture, stoneworking, and royal building practice. The relationship between First–Second Dynasty tomb construction and the monumental stone architecture of the Third Dynasty is important context for the emergence of pyramid building. Yet a single tomb should not be labelled a direct “pyramid precursor” on wall taper alone; that requires secure dating, comparative architecture, and formal publication.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 两座早王朝墓葬保存了少见的墙体、木质支撑和石材加工信息，其中一座墙体底部较厚、向上逐渐变薄，并保存木质支撑和石材加工痕迹。

**English.** Two Early Dynastic tombs preserve unusual information about wall construction, timber reinforcement, and stone working, including walls that are thicker at the base and taper upward, together with timber reinforcement and stone-working traces.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 学术价值主要在于追踪埃及早期纪念性建筑工程的技术积累：墓葬施工、石材切割与结构稳定如何逐步发展，并为第三王朝以后大规模石构建筑提供背景。现阶段不宜直接表述为已证明的“金字塔前身”。

**English.** The main significance lies in tracing the accumulation of engineering knowledge behind Egyptian monumental architecture: tomb construction, stone cutting, and structural stabilization before the major stone monuments of the Third Dynasty. It is more cautious to treat the finds as background to later developments rather than a demonstrated direct precursor to pyramids.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

**尚无同行评议论文 | No peer-reviewed publication yet.**

Egypt State Information Service. (2026, June 20). *Ancient tomb discovery sheds light on early Egyptian funerary architecture*. https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/ancient-tomb-discovery-sheds-light-on-early-egyptian-funerary-architecture/

**现有资料内容（中文）。** 该官方公告报告了Gabal Al-Tair两座早王朝墓葬及更早、较晚墓葬，并明确把“墙体底厚上薄”与后期金字塔工程联系作为初步解释提出；它不是同行评议论文。

**What the current source shows (English).** This official announcement reports two Early Dynastic tombs at Gabal Al-Tair together with earlier and later burials. It presents the tapering wall construction as a preliminary possible antecedent to later pyramid engineering; it is not a peer-reviewed publication.
